notes.title: q.u.q. OST released!
notes.content:
DLC contains:
- 29 tracks, including versions of some of original ones without the aging filter
- full orchestral version of the song "Hacchi"
- Notation for string quartet of the song "Nostalgia"
- Soundtracks not included in the game
